hooks.command:
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
[ -n "$r" ] || { echo "bee: hook transport unavailable (no git root)" >&2; exit 0; }
for b in "$r"/.bee/bin/bee "$r"/.bee/bin/bee.exe; do [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" hook session-init --source=repo; done
echo "bee: hook binary missing (.bee/bin/bee)" >&2; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: node -e "var cp=require('child_process');var path=require('path');var fs=require('fs');var hook=process.argv[1];var root='';try{root=cp.execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim();}catch(e){root='';}if(!root){console.error('bee: hook transport unavailable (no git root)');process.exit(0);}var bin=path.join(root,'.bee','bin','bee.exe');if(!fs.existsSync(bin)){bin=path.join(root,'.bee','bin','bee');}if(!fs.existsSync(bin)){console.error('bee: hook binary missing (.bee/bin/bee)');process.exit(0);}var r=cp.spawnSync(bin,['hook',hook,'--source=repo'],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.error){process.exit(1);}process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status);" session-init
